**Platform:** Linux x86_64. Supported distributions: Arch Linux, Fedora 43+, Ubuntu 25+.

Make the AppImage executable and run it:

```bash
chmod +x Weave-linux.AppImage
./Weave-linux.AppImage
```

Choose **Install MayaFlux** to install via your distribution's package manager (AUR, COPR, or PPA), or **Create Project** if MayaFlux is already installed.

See [docs/LINUX.md](https://github.com/MayaFlux/Weave/blob/main/docs/LINUX.md) for full details.
